Card Q&A.q: I digivolve this card while it’s unsuspended. Can I still trash the top card of my security stack with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may trash the top card of your security stack to unsuspend this Digimon.
[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
